name: qa-audit
description: QA Audit: test a live site after a deploy and get a visual bug report plus Playwright tests to rerun after every release.

plugins.name: qa-audit
plugins.description: Post-deploy QA of a website: flows, forms (never submitted), links and redirects, console, mobile, cross-browser, accessibility, speed, GA4 events, copy and translations; render-checked HTML report and rerunnable Playwright tests.
